ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_O
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_O (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE entry_details
IS

BEGIN
 go_block('dnr_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('don_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 DECLARE
 ---
 CURSOR c1 IS
 /*international address 4/6/11 starts*/
 SELECT a.last_name, a.last_name_suffix, a.first_name, a.middle_name, alternate_id_type,alternate_id, a.date_of_birth, a.gender, a.donor_weight,a.blood_type, a.ethnic_group,
 b.street_name, b.suite_apt, b.d_area_code, b.d_phone_no, b.extension, b.h_area_code, b.h_phone_no, b.m_area_code,b.m_phone_no,
 b.PREFERRED_CONTACT_FLAG, b.email,
 c.state, c.city, c.zip,
 b.INTL_ADDRESS_1, b.INTL_ADDRESS_2, b.INTL_ADDRESS_3, b.COUNTRY_NAME, b.INTL_POSTAL_CODE, b.INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO,
 b.INTL_WORK_PHONE_NO, b.INTL_WORK_PHONE_EXT, b.INTL_MOBILE_PHONE_NO, b.INTL_FAX_NO, b.INTL_ADDR_FLAG, b.INTL_ADDRESS_4
 FROM donors a, donor_addresses b, valid_city_state c
 WHERE a.donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id
 AND b.donor_id = a.donor_id
 AND c.usps_id = NVL(b.usps_id, 0)
 AND rownum = 1;
 c_row c1%rowtype;
 v_intl_st VARCHAR2(500);
 /*international address 4/6/11 ends*/
 ---
 BEGIN
 go_block('don_block');
 go_item('don_block.pb_close');
 :don_block.donor_id :=:parameter.p_donor_id;
 :don_block.deferral_id := :parameter.p_def_id;
 /*international address 4/6/11 starts*/
 IF NOT c1%isopen THEN
 OPEN c1;
 END IF;
 FETCH c1 INTO c_row;
 CLOSE c1;
 IF c_row.INTL_ADDR_FLAG = 'Y' THEN
 --
 SELECT (c_row.intl_address_1
 || DECODE(c_row.intl_address_2, NULL, NULL,', ' || c_row.intl_address_2)
 || DECODE(c_row.intl_address_3, NULL, NULL,', ' || c_row.intl_address_3)
 || DECODE(c_row.intl_address_4, NULL, NULL,', ' || c_row.intl_address_4)
 || DECODE(c_row.country_name, NULL, NULL,', ' || c_row.country_name)
 || DECODE(c_row.intl_postal_code, NULL, NULL,', ' || c_row.intl_postal_code) )
 INTO v_intl_st
 FROM dual;
 --
 :dnr_block.last_name := c_row.last_name;
 :dnr_block.last_name_suffix := c_row.last_name_suffix;
 :dnr_block.first_name := c_row.first_name;
 :dnr_block.middle_name := c_row.middle_name;
 --v_ssn := c_row.ssn;
 :dnr_block.alternate_id_type:= c_row.alternate_id_type;
 :dnr_block.alternate_id := c_row.alternate_id;
 :dnr_block.date_of_birth := c_row.date_of_birth;
 :dnr_block.gender := c_row.gender;
 :dnr_block.donor_weight := c_row.donor_weight;
 v_blood_type := c_row.blood_type;
 :dnr_block.ethnic_group := c_row.ethnic_group;
 :dnr_block.intl_addr := v_intl_st; --jairam changed so
 -- that intl addr is displayed on new field, not on local addr
 -- fields
 --:dnr_block.suite_apt := c_row.suite_apt;
 --:dnr_block.d_area_code := c_row.d_area_code;
 :dnr_block.d_phone_no := c_row.INTL_WORK_PHONE_NO;
 :dnr_block.extension := c_row.INTL_WORK_PHONE_EXT;
 --:dnr_block.h_area_code := c_row.h_area_code;
 :dnr_block.h_phone_no := c_row.INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO;
 :dnr_block.email := c_row.email;
 ELSE
 /*international address 4/6/11 ends*/
 :dnr_block.last_name := c_row.last_name;
 :dnr_block.last_name_suffix := c_row.last_name_suffix;
 :dnr_block.first_name := c_row.first_name;
 :dnr_block.middle_name := c_row.middle_name;
 --v_ssn := c_row.ssn;
 :dnr_block.alternate_id_type:= c_row.alternate_id_type;
 :dnr_block.alternate_id := c_row.alternate_id;
 :dnr_block.date_of_birth := c_row.date_of_birth;
 :dnr_block.gender := c_row.gender;
 :dnr_block.donor_weight := c_row.donor_weight;
 v_blood_type := c_row.blood_type;
 :dnr_block.ethnic_group := c_row.ethnic_group;
 :dnr_block.street_name := c_row.street_name;
 :dnr_block.suite_apt := c_row.suite_apt;
 :dnr_block.d_area_code := c_row.d_area_code;
 :dnr_block.d_phone_no := c_row.d_phone_no;
 :dnr_block.extension := c_row.extension;
 :dnr_block.h_area_code := c_row.h_area_code;
 :dnr_block.h_phone_no := c_row.h_phone_no;
 :dnr_block.m_area_code := c_row.m_area_code;
 :dnr_block.m_phone_no := c_row.m_phone_no;
 If c_row.preferred_contact_flag='H' then 
 :dnr_block.check_home:='Y';
 :dnr_block.check_mobile:='N';
 :dnr_block.check_work:='N';
 Elsif c_row.preferred_contact_flag ='W' then 
 :dnr_block.check_work:='Y';
 :dnr_block.check_mobile:='N';
 :dnr_block.check_home:='N';
 Elsif c_row.preferred_contact_flag='M' then 
 :dnr_block.check_mobile:='Y';
 :dnr_block.check_home:='N';
 :dnr_block.check_work:='N';
 Else
 :dnr_block.check_mobile:='N';
 :dnr_block.check_home:='N';
 :dnr_block.check_work:='N';
 End If;
 
 :dnr_block.email := c_row.email;
 :dnr_block.state := c_row.state;
 :dnr_block.city := c_row.city;
 :dnr_block.zip := c_row.zip;
 END IF;
 ------
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 BEGIN
 
 BEGIN 
 SELECT description INTO :dnr_block.blood_type
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'ABO'
 AND code = v_blood_type;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 :dnr_block.blood_type := 'No ABO';
 END;
 
 --:dnr_block.ethnic_group :=v_ethnic_group; -- SCR 20770
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT credit_sponsor, lookup_id, screener_id, physical_id
 INTO :don_block.credit_sponsor, :don_block.lookup_id, :don_block.screener_id, :don_block.physical_id
 FROM donations
 WHERE transaction_id = :parameter.p_trans_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT a.donation_type, a.procedure_code, a.deferral_reason, a.deferred_thru_date,
 a.transaction_id, a.first_reviewer_id, b.drive_date, a.deferral_type, a.equip_type
 INTO :don_block.donation_type, :don_block.procedure_code, :don_block.deferral_reason,:don_block.deferred_thru_date,
 :don_block.transaction_id, :don_block.first_reviewer_id, :don_block.drive_date, :don_block.defrral_type,
 :don_block.equip_type
 FROM donations a,
 drives b
 WHERE a.transaction_id = :parameter.p_trans_id
 AND b.drive_id = a.drive_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ---------------------------
 --- Added on 05/12/2012; Ashok; IM:5460
 DECLARE
 intl_count NUMBER;
 v_empl_id VARCHAR2(10);
 BEGIN
 -- Get employer id;
 BEGIN
 SELECT employer_id INTO v_empl_id
 FROM donors
 WHERE donor_id=:parameter.p_donor_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 IF v_empl_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO intl_count
 FROM donor_employers
 WHERE employer_id = v_empl_id
 AND intl_city IS NOT NULL;
 IF intl_count <> 0 THEN -- intl address;
 BEGIN
 SELECT REPLACE(intl_city ||', ' ||NVL(TRIM(intl_state),'#@#@') ||', ' ||NVL(TRIM(intl_postal_code),'#@#@') ||', '|| Intl_country_name, ', #@#@','')
 INTO :dnr_block.emp_intl_addr
 FROM DONOR_EMPLOYERS
 WHERE employer_id = v_empl_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ELSE -- local address
 BEGIN
 SELECT A.Employer_name, b.zip, b.city, b.state
 INTO :dnr_block.Employer_name, :dnr_block.e_zip, :dnr_block.e_city, :dnr_block.e_state
 FROM donor_employers a, valid_city_state b
 WHERE a.employer_id = v_empl_id
 AND a.usps_id = b.usps_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- v_empl_id is not null;
 END;
 ---
 /*
 begin
 select A.Employer_name, b.zip, b.city, b.state
 into :dnr_block.Employer_name, :dnr_block.e_zip,
 :dnr_block.e_city, :dnr_block.e_state
 from donor_employers a, valid_city_state b
 where a.employer_id = (select employer_id
 from donors
 where donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id)
 and a.usps_id = b.usps_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 */
END;

 when others then

END;

 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
